children: Ebenezer Scrooge discovered something he enjoys besides declining invitations to Christmas parties: a No. 1 opening.

led the domestic box office with an estimated $19 million from 3,535 locations, averaging $5,375 per theater. The supernatural Christmas tale, starring Johnny Depp and directed by Ti West, added a reported $23 million internationally for a $42 million worldwide launch. Yes, three ghosts remain sufficient to get a man out of the house, and audiences into a theater.

The broader domestic marketplace collected an estimated $86.84 million across 40 reported titles, down about 28% from the previous weekend but up 14% from the comparable weekend in 2025. The top 10 supplied $72.88 million, approximately 84% of the reported total.

For investors tracking theatrical attendance through ticket receipts, the weekend offers two useful perspectives: business slowed from the preceding frame, while the year-over-year comparison remained positive. Domestic revenue through Sunday stood at a preliminary $8.77 billion, up 21% from the comparable 2025 tally. That leaves approximately $1.23 billion to reach $10 billion, with the Sunday year-to-date figure still subject to Rentrak reconciliation.
